viewer: Hindi-speaking 16-30 year olds who watched Ranga Part 1 and were promised Part 2
hook: Ranga pehle dayan nahi thi, wo ek dulhan thi. (over a frozen, cracking screen)
payoff: The village threw the jilted bride out into the snow; next morning only a trail led to every door.
cta: Haan ya Na comment karo. Part 3: Ranga se kaise bachein.
sources: Original story built on the account's own Ranga character (Doomsday Horror). Code-drawn visuals, Kalpa Labs TTS (Aman), studio-synthesized SFX/BGM. No third-party footage or audio.
